client.keyring.title: System keyring
client.keyring.createDetail: To connect to this computer from another device, create a keyring in the system dialog. It will store this computer’s identity key.
client.keyring.unlockDetail: Unlock the keyring in the system dialog so other devices can verify this computer’s identity.
client.keyring.service: The system keyring service is unavailable. Sign in to a graphical session, install or enable a compatible keyring service, then try again.
client.keyring.access: The identity key could not be read. Check its access permissions in the system keyring, then try again.
client.keyring.remote: Complete keyring setup on the remote computer. The connection will retry automatically.
client.keyring.remoteNamed: Complete keyring setup on {name}. The connection will retry automatically.
